item.text: CodeGraph’s stance is local-first privacy: anonymous telemetry is limited to aggregate usage such as commands, MCP tools, indexed languages, connected agents, versions, platforms, and errors (`Anonymous usage telemetry`, `Anonymous aggregate usage answers`). It guarantees user code never leaves the machine and telemetry must never include source code, paths, filenames, repo names, symbols, query/search text, or anything derived from indexed project contents (`Local-first privacy promise`, `No project-content telemetry`). Disabling telemetry means CodeGraph records nothing, sends nothing, and deletes buffered telemetry (`Telemetry off deletes buffers`).
